title: Crystal Baguette Eternity Ring
descriptionHtml:
Straight lines, all the way round. A full eternity band of clear baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise, each stone held by tall gold claws that rise between the stones like a small crown. Bright from every angle, because there is no back to it.

STYLING TIP: Stack it with the Baguette Eternity Band in a colour.

Details

  • Width: Approximately 5mm
  • Stones: Clear baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise all the way round
  • Setting: Tall gold claws between the stones
  • Sizes: US 6, 7 and 8
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
